protocol.scope: Inference-only diagnostic. Do not edit model, training, features, labels or test data. Labels are assumed correct; no label audit is performed.
analyses: Validation confusion and class precision/recall; train versus validation metrics for seed43.
Cross-seed prediction agreement, errors shared by all four, and majority-vote diagnostic with ties resolved by seed43.
Descriptive class-conditional slices: side to move, piece count <=6/7-12/13-20/21+, number of kings on outer edge, pawn presence and en-passant flag. Compare class support alongside recall.

Color-equivalent mirror diagnostic: reverse ranks, swap piece colors, side to move, castling rights and en-passant rank; labels unchanged except optional color suffix swapped. Mirror applied twice must reproduce normalized original.
Deterministic samples from each directed confusion, preferring errors common to all seeds.
protocol.limits: Slices are descriptive, correlated and selected for interpretation; they do not prove causes. Synthetic mirrored positions are diagnostics, not independent validation/test samples. Seed43 was used for tuning. Predictions alone contain no confidence scores.
